youtube.title: Too Much On Your Plate? Morning Prayer Today | Proverbs 16:3 KJV
youtube.text:
Good morning. Got a lot on your plate today? Hand it over first.

"Commit thy works unto the LORD, and thy thoughts shall be established." Proverbs 16:3 (KJV)

Give him the work before you start it, and your mind gets steady.

Have a blessed day. Type amen, and send this to somebody starting their day.

Narration: AI-generated voice. The Word is real.

#MorningPrayer #BibleVerse #KJV #BlessedPrayers #shorts
